Headline: V2 motorcycle was most likely at fault (100%)
Summary: The motorcycle moved into the silver car: it did most of the closing before contact. The motorcycle was moving much faster than the silver car.

Findings.Text: The motorcycle was moving much faster than the silver car.
The motorcycle moved into the silver car: it did most of the closing before contact.
The motorcycle (A) and the silver car (B) collided.

Reasons: The motorcycle was moving much faster than the silver car.
The motorcycle moved into the silver car: it did most of the closing before contact.

Narrative: At 0:02.0 the video shows a collision between other road users, in the lane to the left of the camera vehicle, a short distance ahead.
